<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="ניסן_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518917894_theRebbe_634" batchId="meluket-_D7_A0_D7_99_D7_A1_D7_9F_meluket__BH_POST_1766518917894_theRebbe_634__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In the future, even miracles clothed in nature will be revealed as wonders, because nature itself will be elevated to become a vessel for the revelation of the Ein Sof.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">7)</t>
    <t s="1">And based on this, it can be said that the innovation of "show us wonders" that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="2">is that even the miracles that are clothed in nature will be in a manner of "show us wonders"</t>
    <t s="3">(that they will see the miracle),</t>
    <t s="4">this is also regarding the miracles</t>
    <t s="5">(wonders)</t>
    <t s="6">themselves.</t>
    <t s="7">For that which now nature conceals the miracle within it is because nature</t>
    <t s="8">(even when a miracle is clothed in it)</t>
    <t s="9">is the opposite of the miracle.</t>
    <t s="10">And as mentioned above</t>
    <t s="11">(section 5)</t>
    <t s="12">that the change</t>
    <t s="13">(the miracle)</t>
    <t s="14">that is made in nature is contrary to the laws and properties of nature.</t>
    <t s="15">Therefore,</t>
    <t s="16">miracles that are above nature are more revealed.</t>
    <t s="17">And that in the future there will be</t>
    <t s="18">(also)</t>
    <t s="19">the miracles clothed in nature in a manner of "show us wonders"</t>
    <t s="20">(that they will see the miracle within nature),</t>
    <t s="21">this is,</t>
    <t s="22">because in the future,</t>
    <t s="23">there will be an elevation of nature,</t>
    <t s="24">that even nature will be a vessel for the revelation of the Ein Sof blessed be He that will be clothed in it.</t>
    <t s="25">And therefore even the miracles clothed in nature will be revealed.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The innovation of future wonders is both in seeing them and in the wonders themselves, as nature will no longer oppose the revelation of the Ein Sof but become its vessel.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And this is that the innovation of "show us wonders" that will be in the future is in the seeing of the wonders and also in the wonders themselves,</t>
    <t s="1">for the miracles clothed in nature now are in a manner that even after the revelation of the Ein Sof blessed be He that is revealed in the miracle,</t>
    <t s="2">there remains an entity</t>
    <t s="3">(nature)</t>
    <t s="4">that in its essence is the opposite of the revelation of the light of the blessed Ein Sof</t>
    <t s="5">(except that the revelation of the light of the blessed Ein Sof rules over it so that its actual conduct will be according to His will, blessed be He).</t>
    <t s="6">And in the miracles clothed in nature that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="7">there will be both virtues.</t>
    <t s="8">That the revelation of the Ein Sof blessed be He will be within nature,</t>
    <t s="9">and there will not be an entity that is the opposite of the revelation of the blessed Ein Sof,</t>
    <t s="10">since even nature will be a vessel for the Ein Sof blessed be He.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In the future, the soul will be nourished by the body, because the body's nullification to G-dliness will be greater than the soul's, encompassing both aspects of nullification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">8)</t>
    <t s="1">And one can connect this with the known concept42</t>
    <t s="2">that in the future the soul will be nourished from the body.</t>
    <t s="3">For now the body is nourished from the soul, and in the future the soul will be nourished from the body.</t>
    <t s="4">For although even then there will be a physical body, nevertheless it will be nourished from G-dliness and will not need physical eating and drinking,</t>
    <t s="5">and moreover, the body will be superior to the soul.</t>
    <t s="6">And the explanation is,</t>
    <t s="7">that the nullification of the body to G-dliness reaches a higher level than the nullification of the soul43.</t>
    <t s="8">For that the soul is nullified to G-dliness,</t>
    <t s="9">since it is spiritual,</t>
    <t s="10">its nullification is connected with its own existence.</t>
    <t s="11">And when one effects</t>
    <t s="12">(through service)</t>
    <t s="13">nullification in the physical body,</t>
    <t s="14">this nullification is</t>
    <t s="15">(not from the aspect of the body's existence,</t>
    <t s="16">but rather)</t>
    <t s="17">from the aspect of G-dliness.</t>
    <t s="18">Except that now,</t>
    <t s="19">the nullification of the soul is a nullification of existence, and the nullification of the body is a nullification of the ego44.</t>
    <t s="20">And in the future,</t>
    <t s="21">in the nullification of the body there will be both virtues.</t>
    <t s="22">That the nullification is from the aspect of G-dliness and that the nullification will be in its entire existence.</t>
    <t s="23">And therefore in the future the soul will be nourished from the body.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
